title: Paper v2 (1/3): script inputs and per-dispatch attribution, v1 byte-identical
description:
## As asked

Piece 1 of 3 of LIN-4275 (Paper v2: size against cost, as a chart). The parent's description holds the full scope and design: its `## As asked` block, `## Current`, `## Constraints` and `## Implementation Plan` (the "Piece 1, the tidy" section). Plan Review Verdict comment `1720c7e2-cb61-49b2-9c31-0c001d38c22c` adds builder notes 1, 2, 6, 7 and 9, which apply here.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so on LIN-4275.

### This piece's slice of the approved plan

**What it does:** the version-1 paper scripts read their settings from an inputs file and gain a per-dispatch attribution mode. Version 1 must still reproduce byte-for-byte. This lands as its own PR in LinearViewer, before any version-2 freeze.

**Files:** `docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-scripts/freeze.mjs`, `analyse.mjs`, a new `inputs-v1.json` beside them, and new paper-local tests beside them (as `cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/freeze.test.mjs` sits beside its scripts). The scripts read from, but do not change, `docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/inputs.mjs` (`takeInputs`/`need`), `lib/wall-clock-summary.js:40-67` (`bucketOf`, `BUCKET_OF_KIND`) and `lib/cost-read.js:518-563` (`dispatchesOf`).

**Approach:**

1. `freeze.mjs` and `analyse.mjs` take `--inputs <file>` through `takeInputs`/`need`. When the flag is absent, the call site supplies `inputs-v1.json` beside the scripts, so the commands in `2026-11-05/README.md:20-27` still work. Do not edit `inputs.mjs`. `inputs-v1.json` holds exactly what is hard-coded today: `freeze.mjs:22,23,30,134` and `analyse.mjs:25,29,45-55,140,161 (ticket 'LIN-4257'),194-201`. That covers the ticket, window start, range floor, exclusions, pair tickets and pair sets, plus `attribution: "lineage"` and v1's freeze time.
2. Default guard (note 7): both scripts refuse the implicit default when the target folder holds its own `inputs.json`. `analyse` also checks that the inputs' `window_start` equals the manifest's.
3. `analyse.mjs` gains `attribution: "dispatch"` beside `"lineage"`. Lineage mode stays today's code path unchanged, including the lineage-only `implRows === 1`. Dispatch mode puts each `dispatches` entry in a leg:
   * Kinds with their own mapping use `bucketOf(kind)`: `leftover` goes to the floor, `wake` to keep-alive.
   * `survey-*` and `AFTER_RE` matches go to Survey.
   * Any other `custom` dispatch inherits its lineage's leg.
   * A custom-founded lineage takes its leg from the inputs coding, keyed by `rootItemId`.
   * Do not build a duplicate kind table.
4. Exactness (note 1): `/cost` never sends `incomplete`. A ticket is exact only when its `totalUsd` is non-null. A ticket with any `dispatches: null` lineage is approximate. Never sum partial dispatch costs for a ticket whose `totalUsd` is null and call the result exact. A null-cost dispatch stays null, apart from the zero-request exception Piece 2 may pre-register.
5. Self-check (e) (note 2): subtract the exclusions actually present in the population instead of the hard-coded `- 1` (`analyse.mjs:242`). v1's figure is unchanged.
6. `freeze.mjs` in dispatch mode:
   * Freezes the prompt of every `custom` dispatch listed in `/cost` `dispatches`, via `/dispatch/{itemId}/prompt`, and saves issue comments.
   * Fails on missing or truncated reads (note 6: `/dispatch` `truncated`, issue `truncated.comments`; see the sibling's `assertNotTruncated`).
   * Fails on a kind missing from `BUCKET_OF_KIND` (check membership: `bucketOf` falls back silently).
   * Fails on a custom first line containing "read-only follow-up" that misses `AFTER_RE`.
   * Fails on an uncoded custom-founded lineage.
7. Extra size fields only (note 4): add per-file-derived `testGoldenAdded/Deleted` (or similar) to `size-prs-repo-neutral.mjs` / `coherence-census.mjs prs` output for Piece 2's sensitivity. Do not change the meaning of existing fields.

**Not in this piece:** a shared chart helper, moving `inputs.mjs`, a new after-answer dispatch kind, or a v2 copy of the scripts.

### Testing strategy (witnesses: fail before, pass after)

* Run `analyse.mjs` with no flag on a **copy** of `task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05/`. Its output must be `cmp`-identical to the committed `analysis.json`, with all six self-checks passing. `git diff --stat -- docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05` must be empty, manifest included.
* A unit test on a synthetic `/cost` with `dispatches` must fail on today's scripts. It covers:
  * an after-answer going to Survey, `leftover` to the floor, `wake` to keep-alive, and a build follow-up custom to the build's leg
  * a null-cost dispatch staying null
  * a null-`dispatches` lineage making the ticket approximate
  * a null `totalUsd` never becoming exact
  * each freeze failure firing: unmapped kind, drifted after-answer wording, uncoded custom-founded lineage, truncated read
  * the default guard refusing when the folder holds `inputs.json`
* Guard test: a kind *missing* from `BUCKET_OF_KIND`, or drifted prompt wording, must break the freeze rather than slip into a leg.
* Paper-local tests are not run by CI (`package.json:10` globs). Record the hand-run command and its output in the PR body.

### Acceptance

* PR merged to LinearViewer main with the witnesses above recorded.
* v1 is byte-identical and `2026-11-05/` is untouched.
* No guard or validation contract is loosened.

Session fit: fits one session

Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4275's approving plan-review (comment 1720c7e2-cb61-49b2-9c31-0c001d38c22c, rev 1)

Grounding commits: LinearViewer `b349c219b`, simple-dispatcher `a42456c` (both still origin/main at breakdown, 12 Nov 10:30Z).

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Size of the move

**Size:** just the task
**Why:** Delivers the piece as asked, the version 1 paper scripts reading their settings from an inputs file and splitting cost per dispatch while version 1 still reproduces exactly; neither Survey found anything the change needs beyond that.
**Cuts:** none
**Decided by:** the standing policy

## Implemented (close-out stub)

Implemented as approved, with no deviations from the plan: [PR #2400](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2400>), merge commit `94893cc354d235273a1bba1f8ec21a680a2d86ce`. The version-1 paper scripts read `--inputs` (default `inputs-v1.json`), `analyse.mjs` has `attribution: "dispatch"`, `freeze.mjs` has the dispatch-mode refusals, and `testGoldenAdded/Deleted` were added as extra size fields. v1 stayed byte-identical. The full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail (Surveys, review, close-out).

comments.body:
## Survey open-0: LIN-4426 @ b349c219b

Read at LinearViewer `b349c219b` (origin/main). Nothing later was read.

**Why this will be hard**

1. **The tests cost more than the change.** Neither script can be imported, because both parse `process.argv[2]` and run at module load. A "fails on today's script" test has to run analyse as a child process on a synthetic folder. That folder needs all five `size/` files, because `analyse.mjs:35-39` reads them unconditionally. Freeze needs the sibling's full harness: a stub API, throwaway git repos, and copies of the scripts at the real path (`cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/freeze.test.mjs:1-7`). Freeze's lineage mode has no byte witness at all.

2. **`custom` has its own mapping.** `BUCKET_OF_KIND` holds `custom: 'orchestration'` (`lib/wall-clock-summary.js:60`). If `bucketOf` is applied first, every custom goes to keep-alive, which is v1's error again. The order has to be: `AFTER_RE`, then `survey-*`, then custom (its lineage's leg, or the coding by `rootItemId`), then a `BUCKET_OF_KIND` membership check that throws.

3. **The unmapped-kind guard can't see a dispatch with no kind.** `dispatchesOf` turns a missing kind into `'custom'` (`lib/cost-read.js:548`), so such a dispatch quietly takes its lineage's leg. Freeze already reads `/dispatch/{itemId}/prompt`, which carries `kind`. Fail when that kind disagrees with the one in `/cost`.

4. **`dispatches` includes members the fetch didn't return** (`record.missing`, `:519`). "Freeze every custom prompt" plus "fail on missing reads" means one failed prompt read can abort a rate-limited freeze of about 150 tickets. Decide now whether that fails the run or marks the lineage approximate.

5. **Self-checks (b)–(d) only work in lineage mode.** (b) maps each null `workerSessions` cost to a leg through `bucketOf(w.kind)` (`analyse.mjs:224-235`), (c) relies on `implRows === 1`, and (d) reconciles lineages. An incomplete lineage is null as a whole but still carries partial dispatch costs. Dispatch mode needs its own checks, or these will fail falsely or pass without testing anything.

6. **Small things break byte-identity.** `analysis.json` stores the exclusions in Set order (`:164`) and the text of check (e)'s detail (`:242`). The new (e) must print the same string. Lineage output must gain no keys.

7. **One item goes outside the file list.** Approach item 7 edits `coherence-as-it-grows-scripts/coherence-census.mjs`, which belongs to another paper (its re-run is at `coherence-as-it-grows.md:241`). It isn't under **Files**, and it relies on note 4, which this ticket doesn't adopt. Only Piece 2 uses it. Either keep it strictly additive here, or move it to LIN-4427 and say so on LIN-4275.

**Deeper:** after-answers are recognised only by `AFTER_RE` matching their wording. That is acceptable for these papers, but every later reader inherits the regex.

**What I'd do first**

1. Run the v1 `cmp` witness on a copy to get a baseline.
2. Add an `isMain` guard and exports to `analyse.mjs` with no change in behaviour (the sibling's pattern, `freeze.mjs:272`). Re-run `cmp` and commit that on its own.
3. Write the dispatch classifier as one pure function in the order from point 2, test it, then move on to freeze.
4. Record the decisions on points 3 and 4 on LIN-4275.

## Survey global: LIN-4426 @ b349c219b

**Where it lands.** `docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-scripts/`. The folder is young: one commit (e4fa8d34a), untouched since. Both scripts run at module top level, read `process.argv` on import and export nothing, so a test can't import them as they stand. The sibling `cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/` went through this same conversion in LIN-4333 (509f797e6): `inputs-v1.json` beside the scripts, exported checks, an `isMain` guard, hand-run `*.test.mjs`. The place is converging on that pattern; copy it.

**What the obvious way would do**

- **Default inputs, two policies.** `takeInputs` exits 2 without `--inputs` (`inputs.mjs:27-31`), so "the call site supplies the default" means splicing argv before the call. The sibling chose the opposite: its v1 README commands exit 2, with the fix written in `inputs.mjs`'s header. Neighbours would disagree; say why in the header.
- **A stale header.** `inputs.mjs` calls itself "the one reader … for the four scripts in this folder". It is about to gain readers in another folder, and the ticket forbids editing it, so nothing will notice the claim going stale. Record the cross-paper import in the task-size scripts' header.
- **`custom` already has a bucket.** `BUCKET_OF_KIND` maps `custom → orchestration`, so a "has its own mapping" test passes `custom`, and custom dispatches would quietly land in keep-alive unless routed before `bucketOf`. Also, `dispatchesOf` writes `kind: member.kind || 'custom'` (`cost-read.js:548`): a kindless member arrives as `custom`, and the membership guard never sees it.
- **No real `dispatches` to test.** None of the 48 v1 `cost/*.json` files has `dispatches`; it exists only for records lineages read with `perDispatch` (`task-cost-read.js:116`). Dispatch mode is exercised only synthetically, and the `cmp` witness covers lineage mode alone.
- **A second `AFTER_RE`.** The freeze's drift check needs `AFTER_RE` (`analyse.mjs:29`). Pasting it into `freeze.mjs` makes two copies that can drift apart, the failure the check exists to catch. Give it one exported home.
- **Item 7 reaches into another paper's script.** `coherence-census.mjs` isn't in the Files list. Extra fields are safe, but a "test-golden" path test would be a third test-path rule beside the census's own and `scripts/delivery-paths.mjs` `isTest`. Derive it from `delivery-paths.mjs`.
- **Inventories.** `task-size-and-cost.md`'s Method section describes lineage mode only, and the v2 piece must update it. CI notices none of this, because paper tests sit outside `package.json:10`'s globs.

**Better, at a cost this task can carry:** do the sibling's split (exported pure functions plus `isMain`) first, while v1 is still `cmp`-identical. Give `AFTER_RE` one home. Route `custom` before `bucketOf`, and check membership on the raw `/dispatch` row's kind, not `dispatchesOf`'s defaulted one. Write the default-inputs policy and the cross-paper import into the header.

**Better still, not this task's:** after-answers are found by regex on prompt wording because they are dispatched as `custom`. That missing kind is the deeper cause, and the drift and uncoded-lineage guards work around it; the ticket rules it out. Moving `inputs.mjs` to a shared home and putting paper tests on a CI glob are also for later.

## LIN-4426 summary: PR ready for review

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2400 (branch `feat/lin-4426-paper-v2-script-inputs`, commit 065c2b6e0)

CI: green on the PR (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, secret scan, ci-success).

What it does:
- `freeze.mjs` and `analyse.mjs` take `--inputs`; default is `inputs-v1.json` only where the folder holds no inputs.json.
- `attribution: dispatch` in analyse: per-dispatch legs; freeze refuses kindless, drifted, unmapped, uncoded and truncated reads.
- Item 7: `testGoldenAdded/Deleted` as additive fields.

Evidence:
- v1 byte-identical: analyse on a copy of 2026-11-05 reproduces analysis.json exactly; committed folder untouched.
- New tests: 10 + 10 + 8 pass; run against the base scripts they fail (8/8 freeze, 8/10 analyse; the 2 that pass are the v1 byte-identity tests).
- Unit suite: 24,919 pass, 1 environmental failure (scripts/code-shape/wrappers.test.mjs acorn check fails only when TMPDIR is under a node_modules tree; passes 17/17 otherwise).

Decisions and open questions answered are on LIN-4275.

### Leftovers
- tidied: `freeze.mjs` lineage loop computed a prompt's first line inline, a copy beside its new owner `firstLineOf` (dispatch-legs.mjs); it now calls it.
- tidied: the bucket→leg map (`LEG_OF_BUCKET`) lived in analyse.mjs while its inverse lived in dispatch-legs.mjs; both now sit together in dispatch-legs.mjs.
- tidied: `inputs-v1.json`'s note cited line numbers that this change itself moved; it now names the base commit and the values.
- tidied: `scripts/delivery-paths.mjs` header listed its readers and missed the new one (coherence-census.mjs prs).
- tidied: `coherence-census.mjs` golden fields use delivery-paths' test rule, which counts `tests/fixtures/` that the census's own `isTest` excludes; the comment now says golden fixture lines sit in otherFiles there, not testAdded.
- for close-out: `docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/inputs.mjs` header says it is "the one reader of `--inputs` for the four scripts in this folder"; it now has readers in task-size-and-cost-scripts too. Not fixed here because the ticket forbids editing inputs.mjs; the cross-paper import is recorded in the task-size scripts' headers. No area covers that path.
- for close-out: the bucket→leg rule is still spelled a second time in analyse.mjs's v1 lineage self-check (b) (its own `LEG_OF`), kept verbatim because the ticket keeps the lineage path unchanged. No area covers that path.
- noted: lesson added to `docs/areas/runs-and-dispatch.md` (route `custom` before `bucketOf`; `dispatchesOf` defaults a missing kind to custom).

Retires: `lib/agent-status-store.js`: `listSessions` and `listTaskThreads` have no production caller (deleted with their tests and the now-dead `readHorizonStart` import; runs-and-dispatch, the area of the code this change reads through, was the busiest at 16 entries)

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2400 at head `ecfd1cbc99d5d4d61b8c6cafaeff276a412d8370`. CI green on that head (Unit tests, E2E 1-4, secret scan, CI success). Paper tests by hand: 10 + 10 + 8 pass; v1 analysis.json still byte-identical.

Autopilot cross-check of PR #2400 @ ecfd1cbc9: CI 7/7 SUCCESS on that exact head; 2026-11-05/ evidence not in the changed files. One item for the reviewer to judge, not settled here: the PR removes 4 existing tests (tests/unit/agent-status-store.test.js: the listSessions/listTaskThreads "no expiresAt inside the horizon" and "older than horizon with live expiry" cases) together with 138 lines of lib/agent-status-store.js, outside the paper-scripts folder. Confirm the behaviour they covered was genuinely retired (the waiting-entry leftover) and not removed to make something pass.

## Review — LIN-4426

Reviewed [PR #2400](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2400) at head `ecfd1cbc99d5d4d61b8c6cafaeff276a412d8370` (base `b349c219b`). I re-ran every check below myself in a separate worktree. Nothing in it is quoted from the builder's numbers.

CI: green on `ecfd1cbc9`, 7/7 (Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). The paper-local tests are outside CI's globs, so I hand-ran them (ledger below).

### What I ran
- **Paper tests at head:** `node --test` on `dispatch-legs.test.mjs` gave 10/10, `analyse.test.mjs` 10/10 and `freeze.test.mjs` 8/8, so 28 pass and 0 fail.
- **v1 byte identity:** `analyse.mjs` with no flag on a copy of `2026-11-05/` printed all six self-checks passing. The output was `cmp`-IDENTICAL to the committed `analysis.json`. `git diff --stat b349c219b..ecfd1cbc9 -- …/2026-11-05` is empty.
- **Mutation check (LIN-2274).** I removed each claimed code path in turn and reverted it after. All 16 turned a test red:
  - **Ordering:** custom routed after `bucketOf` (analyse 6; dispatch-legs 2, 3, 5). After-answer check removed (analyse 6; dispatch-legs 2).
  - **Membership:** `BUCKET_OF_KIND` membership check removed (analyse 9; freeze 7; dispatch-legs 6, 8).
  - **Exactness:** partial-sum `g` removed (analyse 7). `!approximate` forced true (analyse 8). Approximate flag never set (analyse 8).
  - **Freeze refusals:** raw-kind cross-check removed (freeze 6). `/dispatch` truncation check removed (freeze 2). Issue truncation check removed (freeze 3). Drift check removed (freeze 5). Uncoded-lineage check removed (freeze 4).
  - **Inputs guards:** default guard removed (analyse 3; freeze 8; dispatch-legs 10). `window_start` guard removed (analyse 4).
  - **Self-checks:** d2 tolerance removed (analyse 10). `sumNullable` zeroing nulls (analyse 1–3). Self-check (e) set back to `- 1` (analyse 6–8, whose single-ticket synthetic population excludes nothing).
- **Live contract (read-only):** `/cost/LIN-4201` lineages carry `dispatches[]` with `kind`, `itemId`, `costUsd`, `byModel` and `dispatchedAt`. All six lineages' dispatch costs sum to the lineage cost. `/dispatch/77d4be68…/prompt` returns `kind: custom`, and its first line matches `AFTER_RE`. That is a real after-answer sitting in a build lineage, the case dispatch mode exists for.
- **Item 7 smoke:** `size-prs-repo-neutral.mjs` on simple-dispatcher gave 322 rows, with golden lines 23,285 of 100,928 test lines. No row has golden > test.

### Against what was asked
- **Approach 1:** met. Both scripts go through `takeTaskSizeInputs` → `takeInputs`/`need`. `inputs.mjs` is not in the diff. `inputs-v1.json` holds ticket, window, range floor, exclusions, pair sets, `attribution: "lineage"` and `freeze_finished_at`.
- **Approach 2:** met. The default guard covers both scripts. `analyse` also checks `window_start` (and `freeze_finished_at` when present).
- **Approach 3:** met. Order is after-answer → `survey-*` → custom inherits its lineage → `bucketOfKind` with membership. Custom-founded lineages read `custom_founded_legs` keyed by `rootItemId`. There is no second kind table: `CODED_BUCKET`/`LEG_OF_BUCKET` map leg↔bucket, not kinds. Lineage mode, including `implRows === 1`, is unchanged.
- **Approach 4:** met. `g` nulls every leg when `totalUsd` is null. A `dispatches: null` lineage sets `approximate`, and exact excludes approximate. A null dispatch cost stays null via `sumNullable`.
- **Approach 5:** met. Self-check (e) subtracts the exclusions present in the manifest. v1's detail string is unchanged (byte witness).
- **Approach 6:** met. The freeze refuses: truncated `/dispatch` and issue reads (`assertNotTruncated`), a prompt-read kind ≠ `/cost` kind, drifted wording, an unmapped kind, and an uncoded custom-founded lineage. A failed prompt read stops the freeze with no manifest. That is the ticket's choice, recorded in the PR.
- **Approach 7:** met. `testGoldenAdded/Deleted` are additive, derived from `delivery-paths.mjs` `isGolden` (a subset of `isTest`), and existing fields are unchanged.
- **Testing strategy:** met, see above. The hand-run commands and output are in the PR body.
- **Acceptance:** byte-identical and untouched, met. No guard loosened: lineage self-checks are verbatim, and dispatch mode adds b′ and d2. The merge is close-out's.

**Regression check:** nothing has landed on main since the ticket (10:28Z) for any touched or read file. `task-size-and-cost-scripts/` has one prior commit (e4fa8d34a), and no earlier fix is re-opened.

### Findings
1. **Scope overrun: the `agent-status-store` deletion (John's cross-check). Confirmed as genuinely retired behaviour, not removed to make tests pass. Recommend keeping it.**
   - `listSessions`/`listTaskThreads` have no caller anywhere in LinearViewer outside the file and its own tests, and none in simple-dispatcher.
   - LIN-691, the ticket that would have consumed them, is Canceled.
   - The removed tests' own header says "No external callers today".
   - The runs-and-dispatch Waiting entry said exactly "delete them and their tests".
   - The four deleted tests cover only the two deleted functions, and CI is green with them gone.
   - It is a loose reading of the LIN-4414 retirement rule ("settle one fix-sized entry in the area its change touched"). No changed file maps to any area in `areas.json`, so the strict line would have been `RETIRES_NONE`. The builder took runs-and-dispatch as "the area of the code this change reads through". The work itself is correct and reversible (revert the `lib/agent-status-store.js` and `tests/unit/agent-status-store.test.js` hunks of `ecfd1cbc9`), so I am not asking for a split.
2. **Minor test-level note, not blocking.** analyse test 7's ticket is also unpriced, so its claim "a null dispatch cost stays null" holds through `g` as well. The `sumNullable` path for a priced ticket is witnessed only by the v1 byte tests through the shared helper (mutation 15 above). Piece 2's zero-request pre-registration should add a priced-ticket null-dispatch case.

### Edges the change left (for close-out)
- **Fix on the PR branch (fix-sized, the change's own line).** In `docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows-scripts/coherence-census.mjs`, in the `prs` row (`out.push`), `testGoldenDeleted: …reduce(…, 0),otherFiles:` is missing a space. It should become `…, 0), otherFiles:`.
- **Follow-up (outside; no area covers the path; the ticket forbids the edit).** The header of `docs/papers/harbour/cleaner-than-it-started-scripts/inputs.mjs` still calls it "the one reader of `--inputs` for the four scripts in this folder". It now has readers in `task-size-and-cost-scripts/`, with a different default-inputs policy. Check for an existing ticket before filing.
- **Dropped, with reason.** The second bucket→leg spelling (`LEG_OF`) in analyse's v1 lineage self-check (b) stays verbatim on purpose: the lineage path is v1's frozen history (see Constraints). No follow-up.
- **Optional outside follow-up.** The LIN-4414 retirement rule doesn't say what "the area its change touched" means for a change whose files map to no area: reads-through, or `RETIRES_NONE`. Worth a line in `lib/prompts/leftover-words.js` / `docs/areas/README.md`. Check whether this already exists.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Paper-local tests (inside: the ticket's own witnesses).** They are outside `package.json` globs. Discharged at `ecfd1cbc9` by my hand run (28/28 pass, 16/16 mutations red). Before the merge: if the head moves, close-out re-runs the three `node --test` commands on the new head. Right means 28 pass and 0 fail.
- **v1 byte identity (inside: Acceptance).** Discharged at `ecfd1cbc9` (`cmp` IDENTICAL, `2026-11-05/` diff empty). Before the merge: if the head moves, close-out re-runs the copy plus `cmp`.
- **Live `/cost` per-dispatch shape and prompt-read `kind`, which the classifier and freeze consume (inside: a claim the change depends on).** Discharged by the read-only checks on LIN-4201 above.
- **Item 7 golden fields (inside: Approach 7).** No test covers them. Discharged by the smoke run above (322 rows, golden ≤ test on every row).
- **Dispatch mode end to end on a real frozen folder (inside the parent's scope; open task LIN-4427 owns it).** Only synthetic folders exercise it so far. It is settled by a path that fails loudly at LIN-4427's 12 Nov freeze and analyse: an unmapped, kindless, drifted, uncoded or truncated read makes `freeze.mjs` exit non-zero with no manifest. A split that doesn't sum makes `analyse.mjs` self-check d2 exit 1. Only the real v2 population can show the coding is complete.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

## Close-out — LIN-4426

**Merged:** [PR #2400](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2400), merge commit `94893cc354d235273a1bba1f8ec21a680a2d86ce` on main, pinned with `--match-head-commit 0b2510ed5920d8a11dd7b06bf83f3b9e4bc112cc`.

**How it meets what was asked:** review's account (comment of 11:22Z, verdict Approve) covers Approach 1-7, the testing strategy and acceptance. I am not repeating it.

**Change I made after the approval (one):**
- `0b2510ed5` — added the missing space in `testGoldenDeleted: …, 0), otherFiles:` in the `prs` row of `docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows-scripts/coherence-census.mjs`. This answers review's "Fix on the PR branch" edge. Whitespace only; `node --check` passes.

**CI:** no CI was skipped. I re-established it on the new head. 7/7 SUCCESS on `0b2510ed5` (Unit tests, E2E 1-4, Secret scan, CI success), read fresh immediately before the merge.
